title: Dataset Distillation Efficiently Encodes Low-Dimensional Representations from Gradient-Based Learning of Non-Linear Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2603.14830v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dataset distillation, a training-aware data compression technique, has recently attracted increasing attention as an effective tool for mitigating costs of optimization and data storage. However, progress remains largely empirical. Mechanisms underlying the extraction of task-relevant information from the training process and the efficient encoding of such information into synthetic data points remain elusive. In this paper, we theoretically analyze practical algorithms of dataset distillation applied to the gradient-based training of two-layer neural networks with width $L$. By focusing on a non-linear task structure called multi-index model, we prove that the low-dimensional structure of the problem is efficiently encoded into the resulting distilled data. This dataset reproduces a model with high generalization ability for a required memory complexity of $\tilde{\Theta}$$(r^2d+L)$, where $d$ and $r$ are the input and intrinsic dim

translated_title: 数据集蒸馏通过非线性任务的基于梯度学习高效编码低维表示
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏是一种感知训练过程的数据压缩技术，作为降低优化与数据存储成本的有效工具，近来受到越来越多的关注。然而，相关进展在很大程度上仍是经验性的。从训练过程中提取任务相关信息并将这些信息高效编码到合成数据点中的底层机制至今仍不明确。本文对应用于宽度为 $L$ 的两层神经网络基于梯度训练的数据集蒸馏实用算法进行了理论分析。通过聚焦于一种称为多指标模型的非线性任务结构，我们证明了问题的低维结构会被高效地编码到所得的蒸馏数据中。该蒸馏数据集以 $\tilde{\Theta}(r^2d+L)$ 的所需存储复杂度复现出一个具有高泛化能力的模型，其中 $d$ 和 $r$ 分别为输入维度和内在维度。
tldr: 本文首次从理论上证明，在两层神经网络的梯度训练中，数据集蒸馏算法能将多指标模型等非线性任务的低维结构高效编码进蒸馏数据，且所需存储复杂度仅为 $\tilde{\Theta}(r^2d+L)$。
